name: aurelia-residences
description: Aurelia Residences: luxury real estate website (React + Three.js) with a Node.js mail & feedback API

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,yellow "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
